name: zju-research-skills
description: A Chinese-first Research OS that connects literature discovery, evidence synthesis, experiment design, analysis, publication, and research translation for Zhejiang University researchers.

interface.shortDescription: Connect discovery, experiments, analysis, and publication.
interface.longDescription: Twenty evidence-grounded skills with one Research Director connecting multi-source discovery, multi-format imports, page-anchored PDF extraction, bounded statistical execution, result-bound figure export, argument spines, conflict synthesis, discriminating hypotheses, writing, review, data sharing, proposals, patents, and condition-aware chemistry comparison through a shared mission and execution-provider protocol.
defaultPrompt: 把这个研究问题推进成从检索、证据综合、判别实验到论文交付的完整 Research Mission。
继续这个科研项目，从当前证据和实验状态执行下一个最有信息增益的阶段。
核对同一分析结果在论文、图件、答审和数据交付中的一致性。
